After the aliases are restored, combine the three name values in B06 into one line in the order shown on your passport. In B08 and B18, put your Singapore postcode in the separate postcode box. If it appears in the restored address, move it from the address line. If B07 specifies a date format, enter the restored date by hand in that format.

For B11–B14, add any applicable current employment details directly to the form. If you use your incoming job to explain your ability to pay rent under B15, describe it as **a nursing job in Brisbane starting on 1 February 2027**. The property manager or owner supplies the submission methods, document requests and information about pet rules.
